Technical documentation for the bgms C++ backend and MCMC algorithms.

This manual is intended for:

- Contributors to bgms development
- Users who want to understand the implementation details
- Researchers extending bgms for new models

## Contents

- [Architecture](architecture.qmd) — C++ backend design and structure
- [NUTS Algorithm](nuts.qmd) — No-U-Turn Sampler implementation
- [Warmup Schedule](warmup.qmd) — Adaptation stages and tuning
- [Model Classes](model-classes.qmd) — BaseModel hierarchy
- [Numerical Considerations](numerical.qmd) — Precision and cross-platform issues

## Prerequisites

This manual assumes familiarity with:

- C++ programming
- MCMC methods
- Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
